name: WayriCAD QuickTherm
description: Saved-board thermal screening with mapped power, native temperature views and optional CalculiX 3D conduction.
description_full: Read-only steady-state thermal screening using declared component dissipation and thermal resistance, optional copper-layer and vertical-path models, virtual heatsinks, mounting boundaries, top/bottom/3D previews, cross-selection and local HTML/JSON evidence. An optional Gmsh/CalculiX mode solves bounded 3D board conduction with a fixed lower-face temperature and power-only heat sources; junction estimates require separate RthetaJB. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib is required. This is not CFD or coupled electrothermal simulation.
